nodes.name: Phantom Thread
nodes.description: Passive Trace generation rate is reduced by 10%.

nodes.name: Cold Boot
nodes.description: When entering a new node, start with -10 Digital Trace (acting as a buffer).

nodes.name: Ghost Protocol
nodes.description: Using PULSE has a 20% chance to immediately refresh its own cooldown.

nodes.name: Void Walker
nodes.description: Endless Capstone: Every 5 Darknet Tiers beaten grants a flat -2% Trace generation rate.

nodes.name: Wide-Band SCAN
nodes.description: SCAN deals +10 Firewall Damage, but generates +5 Physical Heat.

nodes.name: Momentum Strike
nodes.description: Using BYPASS on an unexposed node (without DECRYPT) deals 1.5x damage.

nodes.name: Thermal Overdrive
nodes.description: While Rig Heat is above 80%, all tools deal +20% damage.

nodes.name: Juggernaut
nodes.description: Endless Capstone: Every 5 Darknet Tiers beaten adds +5 flat Firewall Damage to BYPASS.

nodes.name: Deep Siphon
nodes.description: Intel Fragments earned from Perfect Breaches (Trace >= 90%) are increased by 20%.

nodes.name: Emergency Vent
nodes.description: If Physical Heat reaches 95%, automatically consume 1 Liquid Cooler from inventory (if available) without spending an action.

nodes.name: Efficient Hardware
nodes.description: All consumable/hardware global cooldowns are reduced by 50%.

nodes.name: Silicon Baron
nodes.description: Endless Capstone: Every 5 Darknet Tiers beaten adds a 2% chance to automatically loot a rare hardware item upon node breach.
